question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"It."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence** "* I looked at the clock. (3) _______ was already ten past seven.* " **is saying that the narrator looked at the clock and he got aware that the time was already ten past seven. We need to use an appropriate pronoun in this case.
 
• We will use** It **which is a pronoun and is used with non-living things and **with times/dates and days**.
 
 
• **Example**: *It's two o'clock.*
 
 
 
• *​***Therefore, **with the given example and the correct usage of the pronoun, we can say that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"It."**
 
• The correct answer is **option 3.**

**Correct Passage**: *The radio was already on. The radio **comes on** automatically at 7 o'clock to **wake me up.** I looked at the clock. **It **was already ten past seven. I had to get up quickly. I went into the shower, and I could (4) _______ the news on the radio. I couldn't hear it very well, but there was a story on the news about an elephant that had (5) ________ from a local circus*
